svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: O — Retro-future chrome · Thrills & Chills round-4 art concept
svg.text: A 1960s space-age park: chrome rides banded with
reflections, glass domes, a monorail on swept pylons,
boomerang roofs, starburst lamps and sleek guests.

g.text: Chrome = 9-stop band gradient, sky over ground.
Paint: flat, two tones per object, hard split.
Glass: 30% white dome + one curved highlight.
Riders sit under canopies and in saucers.
